name: Media.io
description_en:
Media.io is a browser platform for AI image, video and audio creation, with photo enhancement and restoration among its tools.

For photo work, the key decision is the required enhancement mode and credit cost; free-account content rights and short file retention also affect what should be uploaded.
description_zh:
Media.io 是面向 AI 图像、视频和音频创作的浏览器平台，照片增强与修复是其中一部分。

照片任务需要核对增强模式及点数成本；免费账户的内容使用条款和较短文件保留期也影响适合上传什么。

core_features.explanation_en: The current image-enhancer guide separates Smart Enhancer Lite/Pro, portrait enhancement, restoration, color correction and upscaling.
core_features.explanation_zh: 现行图像增强指南区分 Smart Enhancer Lite/Pro、人像增强、修复、色彩校正和放大。

core_features.explanation_en: The guide advertises upscaling to 8 K; achievable detail and suitability for faithful records were not measured.
core_features.explanation_zh: 指南宣传最高 8K 放大；实际细节及作为忠实记录的适用性未测量。

core_features.name_en: Expiring credits shared across web and mobile
core_features.name_zh: 网页与移动端共享但会到期的点数
core_features.explanation_en: Subscription batches expire each cycle, purchased credits last two years and daily check-in credits last 24 hours under the credit rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 点数规则中订阅批次按周期到期，购买点数有效两年，每日签到点数有效 24 小时。

sections.title_en: Choose the repair before choosing a subscription
sections.title_zh: 先选修复方式，再选订阅
sections.en:
Media.io’s current platform includes AI video, image and audio generation rather than only media conversion. Its image-enhancer page accepts JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP and BMP and documents a simple sequence: upload, select an enhancement mode, preview and download. Smart Enhancer offers Lite for speed and Pro for finer reconstruction; other modes target portraits, old-photo damage, color correction and 2×/4×/8× upscaling.

For a faded family scan, restoration and color correction address different problems. For a product listing, inspect the label, surface texture and color after enhancement rather than accepting sharpness as proof of accuracy. These are editorial review criteria. Claims of natural skin, preserved identity and up-to-8 K output were read as vendor descriptions, not demonstrated fidelity or a promise that every input can produce useful 8 K detail.
sections.zh:
Media.io 现行平台包括 AI 视频、图像和音频生成，已不只是媒体转换。图像增强页接受 JPG、JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP，并描述上传、选择增强模式、预览和下载的流程。Smart Enhancer 提供偏速度的 Lite 和偏细节重建的 Pro；其他模式针对人像、老照片损伤、色彩校正及 2×/4×/8× 放大。

对于褪色家庭扫描件，修复与色彩校正解决的是不同问题。用于商品展示时，应检查增强后的标签、表面纹理和颜色，不能用锐度代表准确性。这些属于编辑检查标准。自然皮肤、保持身份和最高 8K 等说法是厂商描述，未经保真度实测，也不保证每个输入都能得到有用的 8K 细节。

sections.title_en: What the rendered plan actually includes
sections.title_zh: 实际渲染套餐包含什么
sections.en:
The annual browser view showed Standard at US $5.99 per month equivalent, billed US $71.88 annually, and the displayed Premium promotion at US $9.99 equivalent, billed US $119.88 annually. The selected cards included 100 and 400 credits per month,20 GB and 50 GB cloud storage, and1080p watermark-free video export. Taxes and payment-platform service fees may be additional. These observed configurations do not establish renewal pricing or prices for every tool.

The free card offered three daily check-in credits, up-to-one video/image/audio generation,1 GB storage and720p watermarked export. Those image/video/audio maxima are marketing estimates of the same limited allowance, not proof of three independent unlimited quotas. A Premium Nano Banana Pro unlimited promotion was visible, but its separate conditions and duration were not read, so it is not treated as permanent unlimited use. The static HTML also retained a three-day-trial template absent from the rendered selected offer; do not assume that trial applies to this checkout.
sections.zh:
浏览器年付状态显示 Standard 折合每月 US$5.99，全年实付 US$71.88；所显示的 Premium 优惠折合 US$9.99，全年实付 US$119.88。选中卡片分别包含每月 100 和 400 点、20 GB 和 50 GB 云空间及 1080p 无水印视频导出。税费和支付平台服务费可能另加。这些读取时配置不能证明续费价或每个工具的价格。

免费卡片提供每天三点签到点数、最多一次视频/图像/音频生成、1 GB 空间和 720p 带水印导出。这些图像/视频/音频数量是对同一有限额度的宣传估算，不能证明三个独立无限配额。页面可见 Premium 的 Nano Banana Pro 无限活动，但未读取其独立条件与期限，因此不视为永久无限使用。静态 HTML 还保留三天试用模板，实际选中报价未显示该试用，不能推定适用于此结账。

sections.title_en: Annual billing does not make credits annual inventory
sections.title_zh: 年付不等于点数全年随时使用
sections.en:
The April 23,2026 credit rules say web and mobile share the same account credits and benefits. Subscription credits are issued in batches; annual subscriptions receive one-twelfth every 30 days and each batch expires after 30 days without rollover. Purchased credits last two years, while daily login credits last 24 hours and do not stack. The shortest remaining validity is consumed first.

The rules distinguish access to a membership feature from credits and do not allow conversion between membership, credits and cash. Purchased credits are described as nonrefundable virtual products. For platform-caused video-generation failures, the page says spent credits will be refunded; that wording is not a tested promise for every failed photo edit. For an irregular seasonal catalog, compare the expected operation costs and expiry schedule before prepaying a large balance.
sections.zh:
2026 年 4 月 23 日点数规则称，网页和移动端共享账户点数及权益。订阅点数按批发放；年付每 30 天发放总量的十二分之一，每批 30 天后到期，不结转。购买点数有效两年，每日登录点数有效 24 小时且不叠加。系统优先消耗剩余有效期最短的点数。

规则将会员功能访问与点数分开，不能在会员、点数和现金间兑换。购买点数被描述为不可退款的虚拟产品。页面说因平台原因导致视频生成失败时会返还消耗点数；不能据此保证每次失败的照片编辑都会返还，也未实测。对于不定期的季节性商品任务，应先对照操作成本和到期时间，再预付较大余额。

sections.title_en: Free uploads carry an improvement and training license
sections.title_zh: 免费上传附带改进和训练许可
sections.en:
The current Media.io service terms reserve platform intellectual property and give a conditional, revocable right to use the service. Users retain rights they have in uploaded and generated content, but third-party templates and content may have personal/noncommercial restrictions. Paying for access does not clear all stock, likeness or trademark rights.

Section 10.3 specifically gives Media.io a license to use content uploaded or posted under a free subscription to improve products and to train, test and develop AI models. Revoking that additional license requires objection and either leaving the free tier or deleting the account; the terms allow continued use of deidentified, anonymized or aggregated derived information. This material condition should be considered before uploading confidential client work. The pricing FAQ’s seven-day deletion and no-backup statements do not by themselves eliminate the separate training license.
sections.zh:
现行 Media.io 服务条款保留平台知识产权，并授予附条件、可撤销的服务使用权。用户保留其对上传及生成内容本来拥有的权利，但第三方模板和内容可能仅限个人、非商业用途。付费访问并不会清除所有图库、肖像或商标权利问题。

第 10.3 节明确授予 Media.io 使用免费订阅下上传或发布内容改进产品、训练、测试和开发 AI 模型的许可。撤销额外许可需要提出异议，并离开免费档或删除账户；条款仍允许继续使用去标识化、匿名化或聚合的衍生信息。上传保密客户作品前应考虑这一实质条件。价格 FAQ 的七天删除和不做备份说明，本身不能消除独立存在的训练许可。

sections.title_en: Download promptly and check the refund channel
sections.title_zh: 及时下载并核对退款渠道
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ says uploads and generated files are automatically deleted within seven days and that no backup is made. Treat that as a provider statement about service files, not an independently verified retention guarantee for account metadata, training derivatives or every model provider. Keep originals and finished outputs outside the platform.

Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. Although the price page advertises a seven-day money-back guarantee, the linked [Wondershare refund policy](https://www.wondershare.com/refund-policy.html) describes eligibility, consumed-credit exclusions and purchase-channel rules. The credit rules separately make purchased credits nonrefundable. A refund window is therefore not a promise to refund a completed generation because its aesthetic result is disappointing. No checkout, cancellation, support response or restoration job was executed in this research.
sections.zh:
价格 FAQ 称，上传及生成文件会在七天内自动删除，且不建立备份。应将其视为厂商关于服务文件的声明，不能当成对账户元数据、训练衍生信息或所有模型提供方的独立保留保证。原片及成品应另行保存。

订阅会持续自动续费，直到取消。虽然价格页宣传七天退款保证，但链接的 [Wondershare 退款政策](https://www.wondershare.com/refund-policy.html) 包含资格、已消耗点数排除和购买渠道规则。点数规则还单独规定购买点数不可退款。因此，退款窗口不等于对已经完成但美感不满意的生成任务承诺退款。本研究未执行结账、取消、客服响应或照片修复任务。

research_gaps.en: Exact photo-operation credit charges, Nano Banana promotion terms, renewal prices and model-specific output limits were not established.
research_gaps.zh: 具体照片操作点数、Nano Banana 活动条款、续费价和各模型输出限制尚未建立。

research_gaps.en: Deletion and training-derivative treatment were read as policy, not audited; no account or upload test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 删除和训练衍生信息处理仅为政策实读，未审计，也未执行账户或上传测试。
